verdict_reason: IN-SCOPE P1 confirmed live on the repaired store: the SKU mission modal renders product prices in a currency other than the session currency (EUR in a USD session) and disagrees with the PDP price for the same SKU.

completeness.executed: High-value subset driven inline by the orchestrator in a single chrome session
not_executed: Change-scoped regression 002,028,029,075d,083b (blast radius of the shared quantity-control change)
Step 3 independent verification, judgment half (verifier killed by spend limit)
completeness.blocker: Account spend limit (HTTP 429) reset 18:40 Europe/Budapest — infrastructure, not a product finding
completeness.env_caveat: B2B-store defaults were nulled twice today by admin. Both of this run’s windows sit OUTSIDE the null windows, and the P1 was re-observed after the second repair, so no finding here rests on a null-window observation.

test_cases.promotion_note: 37 of 67 Draft cases are promotable on this run (tc:promote dry run). HELD pending confirmation - 5g requires ratification, and MSNF-059 still carries a {HYPOTHESIS} needing --verify.

ac_dod_estimate.ac_coverage_basis: 7 of 10 story conditions carry live evidence this run; AC-1 (x2) unimplementable, AC-2 description only partially observable

findings.title: SKU mission modal renders prices in the wrong currency and disagrees with the PDP
findings.evidence: USD session; modal SKU #55557702 = EUR 455.00 while its PDP = USD 349.00; SKU #201482 = USD 25.00 in the same modal
findings.root_cause: loyaltyMissionProgress exposes no currencyCode argument, so the embedded product loader has no currency context
findings.note: Observed 3x. (1) first seen while B2B-store defaultCurrency was null (14:29:56Z window) - discounted as possibly environmental. (2) re-observed 16:43-16:45Z on the repaired store, ~2 min before a SECOND null window opened at 16:48:29Z. (3) re-observed 17:05Z after the second repair at 17:02:56Z. Identical every time, so it is NOT an artifact of either null window.

findings.title: Anonymous deep link to /account/missions returns 404 instead of the sign-in redirect
findings.evidence: Logged out: /account/missions => 404 Page not found; control /account/orders => /sign-in?returnUrl=/account/orders

findings.title: Two designed CTAs ship as dead locale keys
findings.evidence: redeem_products and redeem_banner.catalog exist in 13 locale files, referenced by zero .vue files; live: redeem banner has no Catalog link, order modal has only Close

findings.title: Zero-target mission renders the nonsensical progress label '1 of 0 orders' at 0%
findings.evidence: AGENT-TEST-MSN-ZEROTARGET card: note '1 of 0 orders', percent 0%, bar width 0%

findings.title: SKU modal Cart subtotal renders as a bare unformatted 0 with no currency
findings.evidence: Cart subtotal definition = '0' while every other money field is formatted

findings.title: AC-1 (notify about new and completed missions) has no implementation
findings.evidence: Backend emits no notification of any kind (0 hits for PushMessage/INotification/SendAsync/templates across 234 files; manifest declares no notification dependency, confirmed live via /api/platform/modules); frontend PR adds no notification surface. The design specifies it precisely (Frames 4, 5, 8).
findings.route: PO / product owner - not a frontend defect

findings.title: Published mission with public=false is visible to customers and pays out points
findings.evidence: AGENT-TEST-MSN-PUBLISHED-PRIVATE renders Completed/100% and granted its reward
findings.note: Owned by the parallel VCST-5319 backend session. Linked, not re-filed. Does not fail this ticket.

findings.title: Card and modal disagree on progress: the modal Targets met counter seeds from backend progress, not from an empty cart
findings.note: Exactly the two-sources-of-progress ambiguity the story review predicted (PROPOSED-BL-LOY-MISSION-001).

findings.title: Order-value card shows only the amount spent, never its target - the AC-2 numeric-goal drift
Accessibility: every Open mission control shares one generic accessible name; modal background is not hidden from assistive tech
findings.note: Focus trap PASSES (MSNF-048) and the dialog role IS present, so the ECL-15.1 prediction was only partly borne out.

findings.title: Danger date badge is distinguished by dot colour alone - no text, icon or shape
Untranslated locale falls back to the raw internal mission name and drops the description entirely
Modal product link opens a new tab, so the modal never closes
findings.note: I independently observed this and judged it correct (useBrowserTarget). But useCloseModalOnRouteChange was written for a same-tab click from inside the modal, so as shipped that composable is dead on its stated path. Design intent question, not a confirmed defect - verify intent before filing (feedback_verify_design_intent_before_bug).

design_drift: Order modal has no banner image (design Frame 2 specifies 170px) and no Redeem products primary button
Card banner 144px (h-36) vs 150px in the design
Mobile is a paginated grid vs the design's carousel with dots
Days-left severity threshold: code danger at <10 days; design renders 8 days as warning
positive_observations: ECL-14.8 schema sanity check PASSES: balance banner reads 16,630, no data.cart:null, 0 console errors
Both modals expose a dialog role, contradicting the ECL-15.1 near-certain a11y failure
All three seeded progress states render correctly (5 days/25% danger, 75% partial, Completed 100%)
Pagination works: 13 missions across 2 pages, no duplicates across the boundary
Expired and Draft missions correctly withheld
OrderValue money fields render in the correct currency ($30.00 spent, $0.00 spent) - the currency defect is confined to items[].product.price
Disabled Add-to-cart and Decrease at qty 0 is validation working, not a defect

regression.note: The suite is authored so a case FAILS while its defect exists, so a low pass rate here is the suite working, not a regression. 15 BLOCKED = 7 declared data gaps + 6 MCP tooling gaps (no route-blocking / perf-trace in this lane) + MSNF-005 refused by the command classifier before any store mutation (store verified intact after).
